description: TS600 series programmable logic controllers. The map holds the first element of each Modbus block.

sources.title: TS600 Series Programmable Logic Controller Programming and Application Manual

notes: A PLC has no fixed list of registers: what you read is the program's own elements. Only the first element of each block is listed here; the others follow by counting from it (the wire address of Dn is D0's address plus n).
X and Y numbers are octal (X0-X7, X10-X17...). Convert to decimal before adding to the base address.
Timer and counter contacts are bits (FC01/05/15) and their current values are words (FC03/06/16).
Reads use FC01, FC02 (X only) and FC03; writes use FC05, FC06, FC15 and FC16. X is read-only.
The 32-bit counters C200-C255 use two registers each, low 16 bits first. Reading from an odd address returns illegal data address, and an odd count returns illegal data value.
The pages used do not give the serial defaults (baud rate, parity, station number): set them to match the PLC's port configuration.

registers.name: M0
registers.description: First of M0-M32767 (0x0000-0x7FFF). M0-M999 are not saved on power-down

registers.name: S0
registers.description: First of S0-S4095 (0x8000-0x8FFF). S0-S999 are not saved on power-down

registers.name: X0
registers.description: First of X0-X1777 (0xA000-0xA3FF), inputs, numbered in octal

registers.name: Y0
registers.description: First of Y0-Y1777 (0xB000-0xB3FF), outputs, numbered in octal

registers.name: R0
registers.description: First of R0-R16383 (0x8000-0xBFFF). R16384-R32767 have no protocol address

registers.name: C200 value
registers.description: First of the 32-bit counters C200-C255 (0xE2C8-0xE337), two registers each. Start address and count must be even
